title: A bound WordPress site keeps a picture drawn to its own shape in the media library
steps: S1: media.draw {prompt, aspect} on a bound WordPress site, no slot.
S2: media.draw {prompt} with no slot and no shape on the same site.
expect: S1: the picture is drawn to 3:2, uploaded under wp-content/uploads/tracy-content/ with an apply id that is not contract-, and the answer says it is in the media library, placed on no page.
S2: SLOT_REQUIRED before the picture model is paid, naming both roads: a slot to place it, an aspect to keep it in the library.
evidence: Issue #255: "draw a picture for the media library" was refused SLOT_REQUIRED on a bound WordPress site; EmDash did it in 22 s

tests: a bound WordPress site asked for a picture with no slot and no shape is answered with its image slots
a bound WordPress site with no slot and no shape says both roads before anything is paid for
a bound WordPress site keeps a picture drawn to its own shape in the media library, placed nowhere (#255)
